label: Diagram 4.1
caption: Diagram 4.1 | Maximum travel distances in a small two or three storey premises with a single protected stairway to each storey | ax. | 18m
description: The drawing contains two rectangular floor plans, one above the other, with the text "See para 4.6" at the top left. The upper plan is captioned "Basement and/or first storey". At the centre of its lower edge is a hatched stair symbol labelled "Protected stairway"; from this point two green arrowed lines run to the top-left and top-right corners, each marked "18m max". The lower plan is captioned "Ground storey". A hatched stair symbol at the centre of its lower edge is labelled "Protected stairway" by a leader line from the left, and a single green arrowed line runs from the bottom-right corner across to the upper-left edge, marked "27m max". Beneath the plans is the line "NOTE: Maximum floor area in any one storey 280m². Restricted accommodation if used as a restaurant or bar." A green banner at the foot reads "Diagram 4.1 Maximum travel distances in a small two or three storey premises with a single protected stairway to each storey".
